[minor/reviewer] D3 [C5 assessment; CL11; alternatives 'Argon2id'; practicalImplications[2]] The draft calls Argon2id (64 MiB, t=3, 180 ms) an 'upward' migration from bcrypt-12 and says memory hardness 'narrows the GPU advantage'.
